title: Report an incident
description: Tell us what happened. Verified reports help other travellers stay safe.
signIn: Reports are linked to your account so you can follow what happens next.
receivedDetail: Only you can see it for now. If it’s verified, other travellers nearby will see a summary without your name.
savedDetail: You’re offline. It will be sent automatically when you reconnect.
describeHint: Include what you saw and anything that would help others stay safe.
whereHint: A landmark, street or area name.
locationFallback: {message} You can describe the place instead.
anonymous: Keep my name off this report
anonymousDetail: Reviewers see the report without your name. We still keep it linked to your account so you can follow its status.
privateNote: Reports are private to you until they’re verified.
announceSent: Your saved report has been sent.
announceSaved: Saved on this device. Your report will be sent when you reconnect.
